## Axure RP license FAQs

### Can I use Axure RP on more than one computer?

Each subscription can be used by the user on any number of computers including across PCs and Macs.

### How can I upgrade from RP 9 and below?

If you are a current subscriber just [download](https://www.axure.com/downloadthanks) the latest version and sign in. For license key holders for RP 9 and below, RP 11 is only available as a monthly or annual subscription. Please enter your email address (or the license key buyer's email) in the [Cart](https://cart.axure.com/) or sign in to the [License Portal](https://portal.axure.com/) to purchase your upgrade to Axure RP 11. Learn more about what's new in Axure RP 11 [here](https://www.axure.com/upgrade-to-11). Please contact sales@axure.com with any questions.

### How can I upgrade editions?

You can upgrade from Pro to Team at any time. The remaining value of your subscription will be applied to the upgrade cost.

### Do you offer a discount to any organizations?

We offer a 60% discount to nonprofits and educational institutions, as well as a 25% discount to government agencies. To request a quote, contact sales@axure.com.sales@axure.com.

### Where is your End User License Agreement?

Axure RP is sold as a licensed product according to the terms and conditions of the [Customer Agreement](https://www.axure.com/license).

### Do you offer Perpetual Licenses?

Axure no longer offers perpetual licenses. Monthly and annual subscriptions are available. Your existing perpetual licenses will not be affected.

## Purchase orders and quotes

Please include the following in your purchase order or quote request:

- The product name: Axure RP Pro, Axure RP Team, or Axure RP Enterprise
- Number of annual subscriptions (monthly subscriptions are only available online)
- For renewals, please provide the original order number and expiration date
- The company name to be designated as the owner of the subscriptions
- Your company's billing address, contact name, and phone number
- The email address for the quote or order confirmation and invoice and, if different, the email address for delivery

Email the PO or quote request to sales@axure.com.

If you prefer, you can mail orders to:
